review.finding: _pr_check ignored mode: in a driven (pipeline) run the PR is never auto-merged, so close-phase failed on every autonomous driven release.
review.suggestion: Expect the merge only for standalone + autonomous/unattended; pipeline = PR left open. (Fixed in f114d7854, re-verified.)

review.finding: ancestry test used ls-remote without fetch; exit 128 gave a false 'not on origin/main'; trunk hard-coded.
review.suggestion: Fetch first, treat 128 as unknown, take the trunk from state. (Fixed except that nothing writes state base_branch; falls back to origin/HEAD.)

review.finding: F7 gated on the latest-tag comparison, which refuses rc-then-final and backport releases and deletes the tag.
review.suggestion: Gate only on tag_exists + changelog_names_release. (Fixed, tests added.)

review.finding: git push --tags pushes orphan tags of refused releases.
review.suggestion: Push exactly refs/tags/v{version}. (Fixed, replay and delta updated.)

review.finding: Guided squash/rebase merge can leave the tag on a commit not on main; nothing checks after the merge.
review.suggestion: Post-merge push-tag step in code. (Recorded as Q1/P8a follow-up, not built.)

review.finding: F1a/F1b/F4 branching is still left to the model in prose.
review.suggestion: Move into a release.py subcommand. (Recorded as P5 follow-up.)

review.finding: F10 clean-tree check exempted only the untracked form of triage.jsonl.
no_decision_drops did not look into decision-drops/bullets/.
tag made on implicit HEAD; tag-remove exit ignored; status exit unchecked before the re-run shortcut.
review.suggestion: Tag the verified SHA, report tag_remove_failed, require pending.exit==0. (Fixed.)

review.finding: commit read from release_state.json unvalidated; ls-remote positional without --end-of-options.
review.suggestion: Validate SHA, add --end-of-options. (Fixed; the re-review found SHA.match accepted a trailing newline, fixed with fullmatch in 228638fc0.)

review.finding: git diff --cached exit unchecked; detail names main on develop.
review.suggestion: Stop with event_paths_failed; use the branch name. (Fixed.)

review.finding: imports private helpers across the plugin boundary.
Re-review: the tree-status exit code was never checked; a failed git status passed as a clean tree.
review.suggestion: Fail on non-zero exit. (Fixed in 228638fc0 with a test.)

review.finding: Re-review: the tree_before baseline changes the operator's F10 wording (git status empty) and can mask a file already modified before the release.
review.suggestion: Record as a deviation for operator confirmation at stop 3. (Recorded, not built.)
